Check out more hidden treasures, including Victorian Christmas cards, a ceramic polar bear, and a Wild West Show artifact; take a peek at exquisite Art Deco vases, a superior snuff box, and two forgotten books owned by Florence Nightingale.
Michael Aspel takes the roadshow to Abergavenny in Wales. Treasures include a copy of a James Bond book bought for 50 pence, an art deco dollhouse, and a 17th-century spoon worth 2,000.

Uncover more hidden treasures, including a restaurant bill signed by two Beatles, a rare Shamshir sword and a silver condiment trolley; spot a painting by a Scottish colorist, inspect bone lace bobbins and cubist pottery.

The team returns to Mount Stewart in Northern Ireland, where their finds include a silver tea set presented to mark an officer's bravery at the battle of Trafalgar, a rare Wedgwood cup and saucer, and a teddy bear that has been in a box for 40 years.

Journey back to the National Waterfront Museum in Swansea for a look at a couple of letters penned by poet Dylan Thomas, a purple wedding dress, and a Chinese tea set; assess a set of ceramic jelly moulds and a pioneering electric tricycle.
